releaseNotes: Review now uses the full workspace; Agent alone retains bottom docking and its live session.
Compact review brief with aligned Run/Rerun controls, expandable instructions and inspectable sent requests.
Review references open focused, syntax-coloured Changes diffs or unchanged source with a distinct From Review marker.
Follow-ups are typed directly in the native CLI; the redundant app-level composer is removed.
Refreshed repository welcome screen with one clear primary action, friendly Git errors and optional technical details.
